rules.cwe_name: Data Processing Errors
rules.description: Legacy category for incorrect handling or transformation of structured data.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call with Incorrectly Specified Arguments
rules.description: Using a named argument whose name does not correspond to a parameter of the called function or method, will result in a TypeError at runtime.

rules.cwe_name: Operator Precedence Logic Error
rules.description: Nested expressions involving binary bitwise operators and comparisons are easy to misunderstand without additional disambiguating parentheses or whitespace.

rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.

rules.cwe_name: Use of Potentially Dangerous Function
rules.description: The 'eval' function and the 'Function' constructor execute strings as code. This is dangerous and impedes program analysis and understanding. Consequently, these two functions should not be used.

rules.cwe_name: Out-of-bounds Read
rules.description: A read accesses memory before or beyond the valid buffer range.

rules.cwe_name: Expression is Always True
rules.description: If the same expression occurs on both sides of a comparison operator, the operator is redundant, and probably indicates a mistake.

rules.cwe_name: Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere
rules.description: A protected resource crosses its intended trust or control boundary and becomes accessible to an unintended actor.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
rules.description: Using externally controlled strings in a command line may allow a malicious user to change the meaning of the command.

rules.cwe_name: Sensitive Cookie Without 'HttpOnly' Flag
rules.description: Sensitive cookies set by a server can be read by the client if the `httpOnly` flag is not set.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrect Number of Arguments
rules.description: Using too many or too few arguments in a call to a function will result in a TypeError at runtime.

rules.cwe_name: Numeric Truncation Error
rules.description: The integer shift operators '<<', '>>' and '>>>' only take the five least significant bits of their right operand into account. Thus, it is not possible to shift an integer by more than 31 bits.

rules.cwe_name: Function Call With Incorrectly Specified Argument Value
rules.description: Calling super with something other than the enclosing class may cause incorrect object initialization.

rules.cwe_name: NULL Pointer Dereference
rules.description: Trying to invoke a value that is not a function will result in a runtime exception.

rules.cwe_name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
rules.description: Downloading executables and other sensitive files over an insecure connection opens up for potential man-in-the-middle attacks.
